The prosecution case is, in short, that on 21-4-1998 the petitioner herein as the complainant filed CR Case No. 53 of 1998 and TR Case being No. 14 of 2001 against the accused-persons in the Court of Magistrate, 1st Class, Munshiganj alleging, inter alia, that the complainant had been the Headmaster-in-charge of Khasmahal Baluchar High School of Sirajdikhan PS and the accused Abdul Barek was an Assistant Teacher of that School; that on 9-9-1993 the then President of that School committee late Newaz Ali handed over a Cheque No. 5075365 date 9-9-1993 signed both by him and then Headmaster Ali Badsha, to the accused to withdraw Taka 65,765 from the A/C No. 674 of the Khas Mohal Baluchar High School from Sonali Bank of Baluchar Branch; that the accused withdrew the money but he did not hand over that money to the Managing Committee, rather misappropriated the whole amount of money; that the accused has not returned that money despite calls and reminders; thus the case was filed against the accused under sections 406/407/408 of the Penal Code on 21-4-1998. 

 8. It appears from the record that out of 4 witnesses, the complainant PW 1 now the Headmaster of Khas Mohal Baluchar High School who was the Assistant Headmaster and Head-master-in-charge of the School during the alleged occurrence PW 2 being a teacher of the School contested with the petitioner in the election of the teacher's representative held in 1993 but was defeated and the accused was elected. Later on, in 1994 he was elected member of the teacher's representative PW 3 a teacher who was also a teacher's representative member in the Managing Committee of the School in 1993. PW 4 a donor of the School Managing Committee who has been holding such post for the last 25 years.
